memes.speaker: employee.a@sdworx.example
memes.statement: Contractor invoices that arrive after the 25th go into the next month's payroll run.

quotes.speaker: employee.a@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Right. So anything that comes in after the twentieth — no, sorry, the twenty-fifth — goes into next month's run.

quotes.speaker: employee.a@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Exactly. So for the November run, if it arrives on the twenty-sixth, it's December.

quote.text: Yes, that's right, it was in the payroll newsletter in September.

memes.speaker: team.lead@sdworx.example
memes.statement: An urgent contractor invoice after the cut-off can still be paid only with the Team Lead's approval by e-mail before the run is closed; without that e-mail there is no off-cycle payment.

suggested.title: Off-cycle payment needs Team Lead e-mail

quotes.speaker: team.lead@sdworx.example
quotes.text: So, an urgent invoice after the cut-off can still be paid, but only with my approval by e-mail before the run is closed.

quotes.speaker: team.lead@sdworx.example
quotes.text: No e-mail, no off-cycle payment. Otherwise we're back to the chaos of last month.

quote.text: Yes, that's how we agreed it with Finance.

memes.speaker: employee.b@sdworx.example
memes.statement: Before the first payment to a new contractor, the contractor's VAT number must be checked in VIES by entering it on the European VIES site.

suggested.title: Check new contractor VAT in VIES

quotes.speaker: employee.b@sdworx.example
quotes.text: One more thing from my side. Since the fake invoice at the Antwerp team last month, Finance asked everyone to check a new contractor's VAT number in vies before the first payment.

quotes.speaker: employee.b@sdworx.example
quotes.text: It takes like one minute, you just enter the number on the European site.
